==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*govoriti}}, from {{der|ru|ine-pro|*gewH-||to call, cry}} with a {{m|ine-pro||*-b⁽ʰ⁾-}} enlargement, perhaps connected to the synonymous {{m|ine-pro|*ǵʰewH-}}. Cognate to {{cog|pl|gaworzyć}}, {{cog|cs|hovořit}}, {{cog|uk|говорити}}, {{cog|sh|гово̀рити}}, {{cog|fa|گفتن|tr=goftan|t=to say, to speak}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|говори́ть}}
** {{audio|ru|Ru-говорить.ogg}}
* {{IPA|ru|[ɣəvaˈrʲitʲ]|a=Southern Russia}}
** {{IPA|ru|[ɣəvaˈrʲitʲ]|;|[ɣvaˈrʲitʲ]|a=Eastern}} (''phonetic respelling'': гворить)
* {{IPA|ru|[ɡavaˈrɨt͡sʲ]|~|[ɣa-]|a=Belarus}} (''phonetic respelling'': говоры́ць)
* {{IPA|ru|[ɡɐʋɐˈrʲitʲ]|a=Ukraine}}
* {{audio|ru|LL-Q7737 (rus)-Tatiana Kerbush-говорить.wav|a=Saint Petersburg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|говори́ть|impf|pf=сказа́ть,поговори́ть|vn=говоре́ние}}

# to [[speak]], to [[talk]] (perfective поговорить)
#* {{w|Russian Synodal Bible}}, Mark 1.34:
#*: {{quote|ru|И Он исцелил многих, страдавших различными болезнями; изгнал многих бесов, и не позволял бесам '''говорить''', что они знают, что Он Христос.|t=He cured many who were sick with various diseases, and he drove out many demons, not permitting them '''to speak''' because they knew him.}}
#: {{uxi|ru|[[я|Я]] '''говорю́''' [[по-ру́сски]].|I '''speak''' Russian.}}
# to [[say]], to [[tell]] (perfective сказать)
#: {{uxi|ru|[[что|Что]] [[она́]] '''говори́т'''?|What '''is''' she '''saying'''?}}

==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{ety|ru|:inh|sla-pro:*žiti}}
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*žiti}} (compare {{cog|be|жыць}}, {{cog|uk|жи́ти}}, {{cog|cu|жити}}), from {{der|ru|ine-pro|*gʷeih₃w-||to live}}. Cognate to {{cog|lt|gyventi}}, {{cog|sa|जीवति||lives}}, {{cog|la|vīvō}}, and {{cog|en|quick}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA}}
** {{audio|ru|Ru-жить.ogg}}
* {{ru-IPA|ʐɨt͡sʲ|phon=жиць|a=Belarus}}
* {{ru-IPA|ʒɪtʲ|a=Ukraine}}
* {{rhymes|ru|ɨtʲ|s=1}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|жить|impf|pf=прожи́ть}}

# to [[live]]
#: {{uxi|ru|'''жить''' [[на широ́кую но́гу]]|to live in a grand style}}
# to [[reside]]

====Usage notes====
Note the stress in the past negative:
* {{m|ru|[[не́]] [[жил]]}} or {{m|ru|[[не]] [[жи́л]]}}
* {{m|ru|[[не]] [[жила́]]}}
* {{m|ru|[[не́]] [[жило]]}} or {{m|ru|[[не]] [[жи́ло]]}}
* {{m|ru|[[не́]] [[жили]]}} or {{m|ru|[[не]] [[жи́ли]]}}

==Russian==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|ru|ѣ́здить||ru-PRO}}

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*ězditi}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|е́здить}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-ездить.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|е́здить|impf|pf=съе́здить,пое́здить}}

# to [[go]] (by horse or vehicle), to [[ride]], to [[drive]]
# to [[come]], to [[visit]]
# to [[travel]]
#: {{ux|ru|[[я|Я]] [[ча́сто]] '''е́зжу''' [[в]] [[Москва|Москву́]].|I frequently go (travel) to Moscow. (abstract verb)}}
#: {{uxi|ru|'''е́здить''' [[на]] [[лошадь|ло́шади]]|to [[ride]] a horse (generally, abstract verb)}}
#: {{uxi|ru|'''е́здить''' [[на]] [[поезд|по́езде]]|to [[go]] by train (generally, abstract verb)}}

====Usage notes====
* {{U:sla:directional verb|ru|multi|impf=е́здить|pf=пое́здить|othimpf=е́хать|othpf=пое́хать}}
:: {{uxi|ru|[[я|Я]] '''е́зжу''' [[на]] [[машина|маши́не]].|I go by car.}}
:: The subject has no definite destination in mind, and perhaps travels in more than one direction. Here, '''е́зжу''' is from the abstract verb '''е́здить'''.
:: {{uxi|ru|[[я|Я]] '''е́ду''' [[в]] [[Москва|Москву́]].|I'm going to Moscow.}}
:: The subject has a definite destination (i.e. Moscow) in mind and the intention of going in a single direction. Here, '''е́ду''' is from the concrete verb '''е́хать'''.
* Imperfective compounds of '''е́здить''' are formed from {{m|ru|-езжа́ть|tr=-jezžátʹ}} ({{m|ru|выезжа́ть}}, {{m|ru|приезжа́ть}}, etc.).

==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{root|ru|ine-pro|*preḱ-}} {{dercat|ru|ine-bsl-pro|ine-pro|inh=1}}
From {{inh|ru|orv|просити}}, from {{inh|ru|sla-pro|*prositi}}, from {{inh|ru|ine-bsl-pro|*práśīˀtei}}, from {{inh|ru|ine-pro|*preḱ-}}. Distantly related to {{cog|en|pray}} and {{m|en|precarious}}.

[[Indo-European]] cognates include {{cog|fa|پرسیدن|tr=porsidan}}, {{cog|kmr|pirsîn}}, {{cog|sa|पृच्छति|tr=pṛccháti}}, {{cog|hy|հարց}}, {{cog|la|posco}} and {{cog|ang|frignan}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|проси́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-просить.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|проси́ть|impf|pf=попроси́ть|vn=проше́ние,про́сьба|vadj=проси́тельный}}

# to [[ask for]], to [[request]] {{+obj|ru|:у(gen)<someone> + gen/acc<for something>|acc<someone> + :о(pre)<for something>/inf<to do something>/:что́бы(past-cl)<for someone to do something>}}
#: {{uxi|ru|[[буду|Бу́ду]] [[продолжа́ть]] '''проси́ть''' [[у]] [[люде́й]] [[де́нег]].|I'm going to keep '''asking''' people for money.}}
#: {{uxi|ru|[[я|Я]] [[не]] [[бу́ду]] '''проси́ть''' [[рабо́ту]] [[у]] [[него́]].|I won't be '''asking''' him for a job.}}
#: {{uxi|ru|[[мы|Мы]] [[не]] [[мо́жем]] '''проси́ть''' [[его́]] [[о]] [[новый|но́вой]] [[пе́чи]].|We can't '''ask''' him for a new oven.}}
#: {{uxi|ru|[[мне|Мне]] [[не]] [[хоте́лось]] [[бы]] '''проси́ть''' [[вас]] [[вы́йти]].|I don't want to have '''to ask''' you to leave.}}
#* {{RQ:RSB|Mark|5|17|И начали '''просить''' Его, чтобы отошел от пределов их.}}
# {{lb|ru|intransitive|colloquial}} to be a [[beggar]]
# to [[invite]], to [[call]] {{+obj|ru|acc<someone> + inf<to do something>}}
# to [[make]] a [[fuss]], to [[stand up for|stand up (for)]], to [[speak up]], to [[petition]], to [[plead]] {{+obj|ru|:за(acc)<for someone>}}
#: {{uxi|ru|[[я|Я]] [[бою́сь]] '''проси́ть''' [[за]] [[себя́]] [[на]] [[рабо́те]].|I'm afraid '''to speak up''' for myself at work.}}
#: {{uxi|ru|[[он|Он]] [[здесь]], [[что́бы]] '''проси́ть''' [[за]] [[бра́та]].|He's here '''to plead''' for his brother.}}
